text:
Everybody saying the new Google Omni model sucks compared to Seedance are right. 

It sucks for the things it’s not intended to replicate. 

btw: the masses don’t care about your fight scene or AI superhero storyboard, everyone scrolls past those. 

Omni excels at exactly what most AI creators are sleeping on right now. Real world use cases:

- Video editing
- Local understanding (like my example below) 
- Explainer visuals
- Educational content

This model will be responsible for bringing the masses into AI video because the next group adopting this technology doesn’t care about making the fight scene. They care about:

- Not getting fired when their boss tells them to go learn that AI stuff
- Making videos that the customers of their client won’t cringe at because it looks AI
- Staying on brand for their business content in a way that doesn’t take hours. 

Here’s a local use case made with a slight remix to @fofrAI’s prompt:

“Make a rapid fire video that shows a different neighborhood of Charleston SC every 1s, upbeat music, include text to label it.”

All things considered on a very basic prompt, this video nails it.
content: Make a rapid fire video that shows a different neighborhood of Charleston SC every 1s, upbeat music, include text to label it.

“Make a rapid fire video that shows a different iconic scene from the best TV shows every 1s, upbeat music, include text to label the series”
